degradation_formula: (M_reference - M_condition) / M_reference for higher-is-better metrics; (M_condition - M_reference) / M_reference for FPR

preprocessing.categorical: OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown='ignore') fit on train partition only
preprocessing.numeric_imputation: SimpleImputer(strategy='median') fit on train partition only
preprocessing.scaling: StandardScaler fit on train partition only for Logistic Regression
preprocessing.missingness_protocol: Test-time Bernoulli missingness masks (10%, 20%) applied to evaluation matrix only; transformed via train-fitted imputer

exclusion_reasons.id: Synthetic monotonic row index; perfect shortcut leakage if retained.
exclusion_reasons.srcip: Spatial memorization leakage; models split on specific testbed IP identities.
exclusion_reasons.dstip: Spatial memorization leakage; models split on specific target lab VM addresses.
exclusion_reasons.sport: Ephemeral port noise; client-side OS dynamic socket allocator artifact (high cardinality, zero intrusion semantics).
exclusion_reasons.dsport: Target server port bias + continuous integer fallacy on nominal values. Note: Behavioral port context is fully retained via 6 engineered features: service, ct_srv_src, ct_srv_dst, ct_src_dport_ltm, ct_dst_sport_ltm, and is_sm_ips_ports.
exclusion_reasons.stime: Temporal metadata; reserved strictly for chronological ordering / session partitioning, excluded from feature matrix X.
exclusion_reasons.ltime: Temporal metadata; reserved strictly for chronological ordering, excluded from feature matrix X.

lr_convergence_policy.note: n_iter alone is not claimed as mathematical proof of global optimality

duplicate_handling_policy: Preserve official benchmark rows; exact 5.16% cross-partition overlap quantified in duplicate_overlap_audit.json
